block.description: The netparse provider is used to parse networking elements, like URLs and domains. It uses `go` packages internally that implement the standard specification.

cidr.description: The IP address and prefix length in CIDR notation.

block.description: Parses an IP address and prefix length in CIDR notation. It uses the [net/netip](https://pkg.go.dev/net/netip#Prefix.Masked) go package to parse the CDIR. For more details in CIDR notation, see [RFC 4632](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html) and [RFC 4291](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4291.html).

domain.description: The domain name. It's the tld plus one more label.

host.description: The host that identifies the domain name.

manager.description: The manager is the entity that manages the domain. It can be one of: ICANN, Private, or None.

sld.description: The second-level domain (SLD) is the label to the left of the effective TLD.

subdomain.description: The subdomain is the left part of the host that is not the domain.

tld.description: The effective top-level domain (eTLD) of the domain. This is the public suffix of the domain.

block.description: Parses Public Suffix List properties from a domain. It uses the [publicsuffix](https://pkg.go.dev/golang.org/x/net/publicsuffix) go package to parse the domain. For more details on the domain parts, see [What is a Domain Name?](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/Common_questions/Web_mechanics/What_is_a_domain_name).

authority.description: The concatenation of the username, password, host, and port. It's separated from the scheme by `://`.

credentials.description: The concatenation of the username and password.

hash.description: The concatenation of a `#` with the fragment.

host.description: The domain part of the authority.

password.description: The second component of the credentials.

port.description: The last component of the authority.

protocol.description: The concatenation of the protocol scheme and `:`.

query.description: A substring of the search component, after the `?` and before the fragment.

scheme.description: The protocol scheme used to access the domain.

username.description: The first component of the credentials.

block.description: Parses URL components from a URL string. It uses the [net/url](https://pkg.go.dev/net/url) go package to parse the URL. For more details on the URL components, see [What is a URL?](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn/Common_questions/What_is_a_URL) and [WHATWG URL Standard](https://url.spec.whatwg.org/#api).

contains_ip.description: Checks if an IP address is within a network.
contains_ip.summary: Checks if an IP address is within a network.

parse_cidr.description: Parses an IP address and prefix length in CIDR notation. It uses the [net/netip](https://pkg.go.dev/net/netip#Prefix.Masked) go package to parse the CDIR. For more details in CIDR notation, see [RFC 4632](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4632.html) and [RFC 4291](https://rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc4291.html). The functionality is equivalent to the `netparse_cidr` data source.
